column1: # Zhang L., Burgass R., Chapoy A., Tohidi B., Solbraa E. (2011). Measurement and Modeling of CO2 Frost Points in the
# CO2-Methane Systems. J. Chem. Eng. Data 56(6), 2971-2975. DOI 10.1021/je200261a (paywalled; not read).
# 17 frost points (gas + crystal CO2), y_CO2 0.108 to 0.542, 293.1 to 4446.1 kPa, 191.1 to 210.3 K. TRC files the frost
# temperature as 'Boiling temperature at pressure P' of the gas phase; method field 'DTA' as compiled by TRC.
# Holdout role: P5/G5 CO2-rich frost points in CH4 (the upper end of the SVE region, next to the SLV line).
# Source: NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (IUPAC ThermoML), https://trc.nist.gov/ThermoML/10.1021/je200261a.xml, retrieved 2026-09-25;
# archive DOI 10.18434/mds2-2422. TRC terms: no warranty by the publisher, editors or NIST/TRC; TRC requests that works
# using ThermoML Archive data cite them. The XML is TRC's compilation of the paper's tables, not the paper itself.
# Flattened with thermoml_to_tsv.py (this folder): one row per property value, digits exactly as in the XML.
# U95 = nCombExpandUncertValue, expanded uncertainty at 95 % assessed by the TRC data-file compiler (not the authors' own
# statement unless the paper gives the same number). Labels abbreviated: fluid/liquid/gas/crystal, CO2/CH4/N2/C2H6.
